name: tablodge-sync
description: TabLodge sync server on Cloudflare Workers, for the Deploy to Cloudflare button.

TABLODGE_SYNC_TOKEN.description: The password your browsers use to reach this server: at least 32 random characters. A password manager can generate one, or run `openssl rand -base64 32`. Save it, because you enter it in TabLodge with the Worker's address.
